name: Robe of the Overflowing Spirit, Purity
body:
Price 22,000 gp; Aura strong abjuration; CL 11th; Slot BODY; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This robe shines with a vibrant purple sheen, its cloth constantly moving and flowing, even when there is no air to jostle it.

The wearer gains a +1 luck bonus on all saving throws, ability checks and skill checks. Wearers with the spirit ability can access additional powers when they gain Spirit in excess of their normal maximum capacity. When this happens, the robe consumes the extra spirit points, and the wearer may activate the ability as a free action, otherwise the points are wasted.

When these robes consume spirit, the wearer may immediately make a new save against any ongoing mind-affecting effects they are suffering from, with a morale bonus to the save equal to the number of points of spirit consumed.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 11,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells break enchantment
